name: legalskills-latam
description: Estándar abierto de cumplimiento legal para desarrolladores en Latinoamérica. Clasifica datos, evalúa riesgo normativo y compara leyes LATAM vs GDPR/CCPA.

audit.description: Read-only legal analysis — produces a Risk Score box from user-provided project description. No external calls.

clasificar-datos.description: Read-only data classification — produces a legal sensitivity table from field or table names. No external calls.

privacy-check.description: Read-only privacy audit — produces a findings report from code snippets or API descriptions. No external calls.

risk-score.description: Read-only risk scoring — calculates Legal Risk Score (0-100) from project context questionnaire. No external calls.

matriz-normativa.description: Read-only regulatory comparison — produces a comparative table from a legal dimension keyword. No external calls.

derechos-usuario.description: Read-only rights protocol — generates a technical response checklist for ARCO/data subject requests. No external calls.
